PICO OpenXR Loader Notice
=========================

This directory contains the OpenXR loader integration distributed with the
PICO OpenXR Unreal Engine plugin.

Upstream origin
---------------
- Portions of the headers under include/openxr/ are derived from the Khronos
  OpenXR SDK and OpenXR-SDK-Source projects:
  - https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK
  - https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK-Source
- Khronos-derived files retain their original copyright and SPDX notices.
- Upstream OpenXR header files in this package indicate the license as
  Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

PICO modifications and additions
--------------------------------
- PICO distributes libopenxr_loader_pico.so as part of this package.
- PICO-specific extension declarations are provided in:
  - include/openxr/openxr_pico.h
  - include/openxr_pico/private/ext_battery_state_display.h
- Additional generated extension declarations may be present under
  include/openxr_pico/ and can remain Khronos-derived where their file headers
  state so.

Redistribution notes
--------------------
- When redistributing this plugin, preserve the original Khronos notices in the
  Khronos-derived source files.
- Include the upstream OpenXR license texts provided at:
  - ../Licenses/OpenXR-SDK.txt
  - ../Licenses/OpenXR-SDK-MIT.txt
- Retain this notice file so recipients can identify the upstream origin and
  PICO modifications included in this package.
